lines: This smiling animal can regrow its own legs.
It is called the axolotl, and it lives in lakes near Mexico City.
If it loses a leg, it grows a new one, with bones, muscles and nerves.
It can also repair parts of its heart, its spinal cord, and even its brain.
That is why scientists study it, to learn how healing might work.
And it never really grows up. It keeps its feathery gills for life.
Would you want this superpower? Tell us in the comments.
